headline: WDAY, ADBE, INTU, ADSK, CRM: Software Stocks Stage Sharp Rebound In July
summary: Investors took profits in high-flying chip stocks and rotated into beaten-down software names, while also seeking the relative safety of defensive sectors such as energy and financials.
